## Findings
- claim-1: The inspected formal source calls \(\omega\) a “ring involution” and specifies \(s_\lambda\mapsto s_{\lambda'}\); it also states that this sends \(I_{r,n-r}\) to \(I_{n-r,r}\). [source-2@L1758-L1767|claim=formal-document]
- claim-2: In the integral model \(\Lambda=\mathbb Z[h_1,h_2,\ldots]\), define \(e_m\) by \(H(z)E(-z)=1\), where \(H(z)=\sum_{m\ge0}h_mz^m\), \(E(z)=\sum_{m\ge0}e_mz^m\). The coefficient recurrence shows each \(e_m\in\mathbb Z[h_1,\ldots,h_m]\); hence \(h_m\mapsto e_m\) defines an integral ring endomorphism \(\omega\). Applying \(\omega\) to \(H(z)E(-z)=1\) gives \(\omega(e_m)=h_m\), so \(\omega^2=\mathrm{id}_\Lambda\).
- claim-3: Jacobi–Trudi and dual Jacobi–Trudi give \[ s_\lambda=\det(h_{\lambda_a-a+b}),\qquad s_{\lambda'}=\det(e_{\lambda_a-a+b}). \] Therefore \(\omega(s_\lambda)=s_{\lambda'}\) for every partition \(\lambda\). Thus the source’s displayed assignment is an integral ring involution, not merely a \(\mathbb Z\)-linear basis permutation.
- claim-4: For \(r,q\ge0\), with \[ I_{r,q}=\bigoplus_{\lambda\nsubseteq q^r}\mathbb Zs_\lambda, \] rectangle transposition gives \(\lambda\subseteq q^r\iff\lambda'\subseteq r^q\); hence \(\omega(I_{r,q})=I_{q,r}\) and induces an integral ring isomorphism \[ \bar\omega_{r,q}:\Lambda/I_{r,q}\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda/I_{q,r}, \qquad \bar s_\lambda\mapsto\bar s_{\lambda'}. \]
- claim-5: For interval ideals \[ J_{r,q;i,j}:=\bigoplus_{\,i^j\subseteq\lambda\subseteq q^r}\mathbb Z\bar s_\lambda \quad(0\le i\le q,\ 0\le j\le r), \] one has \(i^j\subseteq\lambda\iff j^i\subseteq\lambda'\). Hence, basiswise, \[ \bar\omega_{r,q}(J_{r,q;i,j}) =\bigoplus_{\,j^i\subseteq\nu\subseteq r^q}\mathbb Z\bar s_\nu =J_{q,r;j,i}. \] The equivalence also holds when \(i=0\) or \(j=0\), since both rectangles are empty.
## Strategy
Use [source-2@L1758-L1767|claim=formal-document]: it explicitly calls \(\omega\) a ring involution and defines \(s_\lambda\mapsto s_{\lambda'}\). Thus \(\omega(s_\lambda)=s_{\lambda'}\) and \(\omega^2=\mathrm{id}\) are source-grounded integrally.
